summary: ROUND 11.2 TASK 8 — Public SEO pages /traits and /stats. All 7 frontend tests (FE-T8.01 through FE-T8.07) PASSED on the public preview URL. Logged-out rendering, SEO meta tags, CTAs, mobile responsive classes, robots.txt and sitemap.xml all verified.

FE-T8.01_traits_logged_out_render.details: Page renders without redirect at /traits with localStorage cleared. data-testid='public-traits-page' visible, H1 'Tratti degli Avventurieri' present, 41 public-trait-card-* cards rendered (>= 30 required). No redirect to /login or /.

FE-T8.02_stats_logged_out_render.details: data-testid='public-stats-page' visible, H1 'Statistiche degli Avventurieri' present. All 11 required stat cards present: strength, agility, intellect, endurance, faith, stamina, morale, level, experience, power_score, rarity.

FE-T8.03_seo_meta_tags.details: /traits: document.title == 'Tratti degli Avventurieri — Orbus Online: Guild Master'; description 200+ chars containing 'Orbus Online'; og:title, og:url ('https://orbusonline.net/traits'), og:type='article', og:site_name='Orbus Online: Guild Master' all present; canonical == 'https://orbusonline.net/traits'. /stats: analogous with canonical='https://orbusonline.net/stats'. SeoHead useEffect injection works as intended.

FE-T8.04_cta_buttons.details: Both pages: public-cta-hero-register is <a href='/register'>, public-cta-hero-login is <a href='/login'>. Footer duplicates public-cta-footer-register and public-cta-footer-login both exist.

FE-T8.05_mobile_responsive_tailwind.details: public-cta-hero contains both 'flex-col' and 'sm:flex-row' classes on /traits and /stats. public-traits-group-* and public-stats-group-* all contain 'grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3' responsive grid classes. Verified on viewport 375x800.

FE-T8.06_robots_and_sitemap.details: GET /robots.txt → 200; contains 'User-agent: *', 'Sitemap: https://orbusonline.net/sitemap.xml', 'Allow: /traits', 'Allow: /stats', 'Disallow: /admin'. NOTE: Cloudflare-managed content signals block is automatically prepended to robots.txt by the edge proxy, but our app-level rules are appended below — both bots will see them. GET /sitemap.xml → 200; valid XML with all 5 <loc>: /, /guide, /traits, /stats, /leaderboard/guilds.

FE-T8.07_public_navbar_logged_out.details: public-navbar-login present with href='/login'; public-navbar-register present with href='/register'; public-navbar-dashboard NOT present (correctly hidden for logged-out).

robots_txt_observation: Cloudflare edge prepends a managed 'Content-Signal' block listing bot-specific Disallow directives (Amazonbot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, etc.). Our app-level robots.txt is served verbatim AFTER that block. All required directives are present and parseable. No action needed — this is normal edge behavior and the standard robots.txt parser concatenates all User-agent blocks.
critical_code_review_comments: SeoHead.jsx cleanup logic correctly restores prevTitle and prev meta values on unmount — good defensive design for SPA navigation.
TraitsPublic/StatsPublic fetch /api/traits/catalog and /api/stats/catalog with no auth requirement — confirmed these endpoints respond to anonymous users (data rendered with 41 traits and 11 stats).
PublicNavbar.jsx uses useAuth() but does not crash when no user is present — gracefully shows login+register CTAs as expected.
test_credentials: not needed — all tests run logged-out
context_for_next_testing_agent: ROUND 11.2 TASK 8 SEO pages are fully verified and passing.
